metadata.title: Near AI for VS Code extension

components.title: Extension
components.description: The locally installed VS Code extension.

implemented-requirements.description: The gate decides each request before the settings layer can allow it.

statements.description: The extension sends each tool request through its gate decision function. The floor remains enforced and no setting can turn it off.
statements.remarks: Your organization assigns the approvals and grants the gate evaluates.

implemented-requirements.description: The extension writes gate decision records from its project, workspace-free and sub-agent runtimes to bounded local JSONL logs. The log redacts token-shaped strings.

statements.description: The extension writes gate decision records from its project, workspace-free and sub-agent runtimes to bounded local JSONL logs. The log redacts token-shaped strings.
statements.remarks: Your organization selects the events and components to log, reviews log coverage, and defines retention and forwarding for the deployment.

props.name: limitation
props.value: Local gate decision records cover only extension decisions. They do not establish deployment-wide event selection, retention, or monitoring.

implemented-requirements.description: The extension records gate decision times from its runtime clock as integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

statements.description: The extension records gate decision times from its runtime clock as integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
statements.remarks: Your organization sets the required granularity and verifies clock synchronization and timestamp handling for the deployed components.

props.name: limitation
props.value: This evidence covers extension gate decision timestamps. Deployment clock synchronization and timestamp coverage for other components require separate evidence.

implemented-requirements.description: When the extension cannot write its gate decision log, it shows a local VS Code warning. The warning reports the failure once per log writer and omits the storage path.

statements.description: When the extension cannot write its gate decision log, it shows a local VS Code warning. The warning reports the failure once per log writer and omits the storage path.
statements.remarks: Your organization defines the recipients, timing and response actions for audit failures and verifies delivery in the assessed deployment.

props.name: limitation
props.value: The local warning covers extension gate log writes. Delivery to designated operators, capacity warnings and deployment response require separate evidence.

implemented-requirements.description: On POSIX filesystems the extension creates its decision log directory and new log files without group or other access, and retains those permissions through local rotation.

statements.description: On POSIX filesystems the extension creates its decision log directory and new log files without group or other access, and retains those permissions through local rotation.
statements.remarks: Your organization verifies deployment access, audit retention and monitoring, and tests alerts for unauthorized activity.

props.name: limitation
props.value: The result covers freshly created local extension logs on POSIX. Windows ACLs, pre-existing files, same-user tampering, protected storage and unauthorized activity alerts require separate evidence.

statements.description: The route decision refuses content above an endpoint's ceiling and requires the endpoint facts that its policy names.
statements.remarks: Your organization supplies approved endpoint and authorization facts.

statements.description: The gate applies its floor before settings and no option can turn that floor off.
statements.remarks: Your organization decides which approvals and policy grants to issue.

statements.description: A raised chat label is kept when the chat is reopened and shown beside the selected model.
statements.remarks: Your organization defines labels and handling rules.

statements.description: The extension emits preflight and preview event types to its configured audit store when it evaluates an approval request.
statements.remarks: Your organization defines the fields required for each approved audit event and verifies coverage and retention in the deployment.

props.name: limitation
props.value: The approval test verifies the extension's preflight and preview audit event types. Required audit fields and coverage across assessed components need separate evidence.

statements.description: A forged or stale approval attribution is not accepted as a credential-shaped owner.
statements.remarks: Your organization enrols and administers recognized people and credentials.

props.name: limitation
props.value: Approval attribution is verified for extension decisions. The deployment still needs evidence of authenticator issuance, protection, recovery, rotation and revocation.

statements.description: The outbound route check refuses an unlisted model before it is used.
statements.remarks: Your organization configures endpoints and the network boundary.

statements.description: The extension's crypto inventory records its AES-256-GCM use and the collector reports that entry's documented standing.
statements.remarks: Your organization manages platform secret-storage protection.

props.name: limitation
props.value: The crypto inventory documents the AES-256-GCM entry. It does not establish key management practices or approved cryptographic configurations for a deployment.

implemented-requirements.description: Encrypted project state stored by Git sync.

statements.description: Optional Git project sync stores encrypted objects in the remote repository and refuses modified sealed objects on restore.
statements.remarks: Your organization defines information in scope and verifies protection for local state, hosted stores and backups in the deployment.

props.name: limitation
props.value: This evidence covers encrypted project state stored by the optional Git sync feature. Other local and hosted information stores need separate evidence.

statements.description: Approval previews redact sensitive input before they are presented for approval.
statements.remarks: Your organization decides what its personnel may disclose and retain.

statements.description: The starting rules keep Controlled Goods content on this computer while third-party encrypted storage remains unresolved.

implemented-requirements.description: TEE eligibility and official decisions remain unsettled.

statements.description: The starting rules keep Controlled Goods content on this computer while TEE eligibility remains unresolved.

implemented-requirements.description: TEE and third-party encrypted storage remain unsettled.

statements.description: The starting rules keep ITAR content on this computer while TEE eligibility remains unresolved.
The starting rules keep ITAR content on this computer while third-party encrypted storage remains unresolved.
